obsah:
Triple exhibitions are always more demanding, both in coordinating times and the team. If workshops are added, it's even more demanding. Martin Šimůnek, Michal Budský and Mára Tryner set off on a longer route to Bartošovice and Vrbátky, where crowds of spectators and bike enthusiasts awaited them.


The guys showed what they could and at the same time taught those interested Trial and MTB in our workshops. Vlasta, Lukáš Valný and Tobík Dolák went the opposite way to Malé Žernoseky, where besides the exhibition their task was a mini workshop for visitors.


After swapping slots with the dog handlers (so the dogs could have some peace), we rode the show, tested the local concrete walls a bit and held a mini workshop. Thanks for the invitation and the great turnout.
